notes.title: Minor update – important for some Windows 11 users
notes.content:
On some Windows 11 configurations, some players had issues with the game not starting. If you encountered such problems, please reinstall the game. It will then work.
Have fun with the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43632127/c832f06148e4e7b265acd5c7775eca429bbdeac6.png"]

notes.title: Fixed a nasty bug. Now the game should start again!
notes.content:
Fixed a nasty bug that prevented the game from starting on some systems. Now the game should start again without issues!
We are sorry for this problem.

notes.title: Braking news: Sequel to "Sweet Science" announced!
notes.content:
More to come!
We are working on a sequel to "Sweet Science". We don't want to give you too many spoilers, but the working title is "Azuki Afterstory", so it will center around Azuki, your favorite character from Sweet Science... But of course Patti, Marie and Sylvia will also feature, as will a certain robot that you might have seen elsewhere. And then there's the little girl on the picture. Who is she...? (Make your guess!)
Stay tuned if you want to be updated on the progress: join our brand new Discord channel "The Last Secret" and our new subreddt r/TheLastSecret.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43632127/0b6fa8ea188de4179fe45e79ae439344f03ba672.png

notes.title: A better game with better music
notes.content:
We have updated the game for even more fun:
- We've added lofi background music tracks for the math and astronomy class as an alternative to the classical music by Bach. You can chose in the settings which style you prefer. It might be easier to focus on a puzzle with the lofi music instead of Bach, but it's up to you. :)
- Improved the explanation regarding the story guide
- Corrected some spelling
